paragraphs: R' Shimon Hasida: Nedarim. In Hagigah 13, end of side b: “the Pious.” R' Aha bar Avira said in R' Shimon Hasida's name. Rav Bibi bar Dela reports in his name. Rav Bibi bar Giddel reports in his name. Rav Huna bar Torta came before him. Rav Huna bar Bizna reports in his name. R' Hana bar Bizna reports in his name. R' Yonah reports in his name: Jerusalem Ma'asrot 1:2 and Keitzad Mevarekhin, end of mishnah 1. R' Yaakov bar Idi reports in his name; see his entry.
